clusters.headline: Guinea rubbish landfill collapse kills 30

clusters.headline: Theft cases in homes jump 25% in first half of 2026 even as Singapore's overall crime rate stays stable
clusters.summary: There were 459 theft in dwelling cases at residential premises in the first six months of the year, up 25.1 per cent from 367 cases over the same period in 2025.

clusters.headline: 20 bookshops unite for Singapore's first Indie Bookshop Day, with book talks, stamp trails and more
clusters.summary: The inaugural event will take place from Oct 2 to 4 with 20 indie bookshops across Singapore hosting various activities celebrating books, readers and the communities around them.

clusters.headline: Far from home, Ukrainians abroad mark 35 years of independence as war with Russia drags on
clusters.summary: For 70,000 displaced Ukrainians living in Belgium, the hope of returning home remains, even as escalating Russian attacks and air-defence shortages put fresh pressure on Kyiv's European allies.

clusters.headline: Africa: Inaugural Africa Business Investment Summit Convenes 27-28 August in Washington DC
clusters.summary: [Africa Business Investment Summit] Africa's business leaders will convene in Washington D.C., for the inaugural Africa Business Investment Summit (ABIS) 2026, taking place at MGM National Harbor 27-28 August 2026 as the centerpiece of Millennium Excellence Awards America.

clusters.headline: Ex-employee let go after probation without one month's notice wins claim against law firm
clusters.summary: The law firm had argued against having to pay one month's salary in lieu of notice, saying the man had not been terminated but that his probation period had expired.
